blocker_or_note: Simple intercept-only binomial; no fixed effects or RE. drmTMB supports basic binomial via stats::binomial(link="logit").
Simple intercept-only binomial on named response. Expressible as univariate Bernoulli.
Binomial with two-column response (successes/weights). drmTMB supports cbind(successes, failures) syntax.

Unsupported glmmTMB-specific autoregressive ar1() covariance structure. drmTMB does not implement ar1, cs, diag, homcs, or hetar1 (R/family.R does not list these, design doc 01-formula-grammar.md does not mention them).
Unsupported ar1() covariance structure. Same blocker as fm_ar1.
Unsupported compound-symmetry cs() covariance structure. drmTMB does not implement cs (design doc 01-formula-grammar.md, R/family.R).
Unsupported cs() covariance structure. Same blocker as fm_cs1.
Unsupported diagonal-covariance diag() structure. drmTMB does not implement diag (design doc 01-formula-grammar.md, R/family.R).
Two independent Gaussian location terms: intercept + slope. Expressible as separate (1 | Subject) and (0 + Days | Subject) terms, which drmTMB implements. Has lmer twin fm_diag2_lmer.
Unsupported homogeneous compound-symmetry homcs() structure. Not listed in drmTMB supported RE (design doc 01-formula-grammar.md, R/family.R).
Unsupported heterogeneous autoregressive hetar1() structure. Not in drmTMB RE documentation or family.R.

Nested grouping (1 | Subject/fDays) is REJECTED by drmTMB. Verified: "Random-effect grouping terms must be simple variables. Use syntax like `(1 | id)`, `(0 + x | id)`, or `(1 + x | p | id)`." The earlier claim that drmTMB supports nested structures via formula expansion was WRONG and is corrected here. The lmer twin fm_nest_lmer exists but cannot be paired.
Gaussian fixed-effects regression with no random effects. Fully expressible; drmTMB handles fixed-effect models.
Gaussian location with correlated intercept-slope block (Days | Subject). Unstructured covariance; expressible as standard (1+Days | Subject) in drmTMB. Has lmer twin fm_us1_lmer.
Gaussian location with only random slope (no fixed slope). Expressible as (1 + Days | Subject) in drmTMB notation. This is the random-slope form of the model.
Standard Gaussian location mixed model: fixed slope + random intercept. One of the most common and basic drmTMB use cases (design doc 01, line 127).
Gaussian location mixed model with fixed intercept and correlated random intercept-slope. Expressible as (1 + Days | Subject). Core drmTMB model.

Binomial (logit) mixed model with **correlated** intercept-slope `(Days | Subject)`. drmTMB only supports **independent** random intercepts and slopes for binomial: `(1 | id) + (0 + x | id)` (design doc 01, line 177). Verified: attempt to fit fails with "Only independent binomial `mu` random intercepts and slopes are implemented in this slice."

Bernoulli mixed model with **correlated** intercept-slope. Same blocker as fm2Bf: drmTMB binomial does not support correlated slope blocks, only independent terms. Verified: "Only independent binomial `mu` random intercepts and slopes are implemented".
Unsupported diag() covariance structure. Same blocker as fm_diag1.
Gaussian location with independent intercept and slope (not correlated). Same structure as fm_diag2; expressible via two separate RE terms.
Gamma family (link=log) with correlated random intercept-slope. drmTMB implements Gamma mean-CV mixed models (design doc 01, line 108). Expressible.

NB2 with **correlated** intercept-slope `(Days | Subject)`. Design 257 Wave 2.5 admits the exact complete-data unlabelled `(1 + x | g)` ML-Laplace route as `mc-0719` (`point_fit_recovery` only). Zero-inflated or truncated NB2, REML, missing-response, labelled, and mixed `(1|g)+(1+x|g)` remain rejected.

Poisson with **correlated** intercept-slope `(Days | Subject)`. Design 257 Wave 2 admits the exact complete-data unlabelled `(1 + x | g)` ML-Laplace route as `mc-0718` (`point_fit_recovery` only). NB2, REML, missing-response, labelled, and mixed `(1|g)+(1+x|g)` remain rejected.
Gaussian fixed-effects model (no RE). Simple linear regression. Fully expressible.
Gamma fixed-effects model (no RE). drmTMB supports fixed-effect Gamma models.
NB2 fixed-effects model (no RE). drmTMB supports fixed-effect NB2 models.

Poisson with **correlated** intercept-slope `(Days | Subject)` (despite name "ZIP", no zero-inflation formula is present). Same admitted wedge as fm2P: `mc-0718` complete-data unlabelled ML-Laplace only.
Gaussian fixed-effects model with multiple predictors and no RE. Fully expressible linear regression.
Gaussian mixed model with two independent random-intercept grouping variables (batch, sample). drmTMB supports multiple independent random intercepts via separate (1 | group1) + (1 | group2) terms.
Binomial mixed model with two-column response and random intercept. Expressible via cbind(successes, failures) syntax with (1 | herd) RE.
Binomial mixed model with fixed effect + random intercept on two-column response. Same as gm0 with an additional fixed predictor. Fully expressible.
